name: v2.11.0
body:
## Highlights

- **Drop EOL Python 3.9 and 3.10** (`requires-python = ">=3.11"`), remove `typing-extensions` dependency and `<3.11` compatibility shims
- **Official Python 3.11–3.15 support** (CI matrix, PyPI classifiers, PEP 639 license metadata)
- **Updated CI, docs, tooling, and Bitwarden (`bw`) example asset patterns**

## What’s Changed

* chore: general maintenance, Python 3.11–3.15 support, and CI fixes (#185) @basnijholt
* ⬆️ Update python Docker tag (#183) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update actions/setup-python action to v7 (#178) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update astral-sh/setup-uv action to v10 (#182) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update actions/checkout action to v7 (#176) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update actions/cache action to v6 (#177) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update codecov/codecov-action action to v7 (#175) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update actions/upload-pages-artifact action to v5 (#166) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update release-drafter/release-drafter action to v7 (#161) @renovate[bot]
* ⬆️ Update python to v3.14.6 (#173) @renovate[bot]

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/basnijholt/dotbins/compare/v2.10.2...v2.11.0
